components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Blue-filled action for the main submission or entry point.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px; color: #f7fbff; border: 1px solid rgba(105,151,200,.42); border-radius: 9px; background: linear-gradient(105deg, #315f92, #3b6c9e); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(29,74,119,.18); font: 700 13px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: filter .14s ease, box-shadow .14s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(29,74,119,.24); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fc4bc; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:active { filter: brightness(.96); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Quiet alternative action with a translucent fill and cool outline.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 43px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 15px; padding: 0 16px; color: #c4d3e6; border: 1px solid rgba(161,180,202,.22); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); font: 700 13px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: color .14s ease, background-color .14s ease, border-color .14s ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(0,217,208,.25); background: rgba(255,255,255,.045); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0,217,208,.72); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark compact text input with a blue focus shift.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #b7c4d5; font: 700 13px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 43px; padding: 0 12px; color: #edf2f7; border: 1px solid rgba(161,187,220,.15); border-radius: 9px; background: #0a1018; font: 400 14px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color .14s ease, box-shadow .14s ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #66758a; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: rgba(73,143,255,.58); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(67,136,255,.1); outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0,217,208,.72); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation Link
components.description: Sidebar link with a muted resting state and blue-tinted current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 43px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; color: #99a8bb; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font: 600 13px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color .14s ease, background-color .14s ease, border-color .14s ease; } .ds-nav:hover { color: #e7f0ff; border-color: rgba(169,189,213,.13); background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); } .ds-nav[aria-current='page'] { color: #dceaff; border-color: rgba(105,151,200,.22); background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(105,151,200,.16), rgba(105,151,200,.05)); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fc4bc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Severity Chip
components.description: Semantic severity label for validation and compliance states.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 12px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; } .ds-chip--low { color: #a4c6e8; border-color: rgba(105,151,200,.3); background: rgba(105,151,200,.11); } .ds-chip--medium { color: #e0c58f; border-color: rgba(197,161,101,.3); background: rgba(197,161,101,.1); } .ds-chip--high { color: #e5a0a5; border-color: rgba(201,121,130,.32); background: rgba(201,121,130,.12); }

narrative.overview:
ApaarAnvaya's web UI is a dark, information-dense workspace for reviewing academic records and their trust signals. Deep blue-gray surfaces carry the working content; restrained blue and teal accents identify navigation, actions, and integrity cues, while amber and red distinguish attention states. The visual voice is precise and operational rather than ornamental.

The shared authenticated shell anchors desktop screens with a persistent role-based sidebar and a sticky workspace header. Panels, tables, filters, and compact labels keep dashboards and review workflows scannable. The public home and sign-in surfaces use the same dark foundation with a more open split composition, but remain part of the same interface family.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, layered blue-gray surfaces with soft borders.
IBM Plex Sans for headings and interface copy, with IBM Plex Mono for hashes and identifiers.
Blue and teal actions with amber/red status signaling.
Compact, role-oriented navigation and data presentation.

rules.name: The Signal-Color Rule
rules.body: Keep blue and teal as controlled action and integrity cues; reserve amber and red for warning and error meaning rather than general decoration.

rules.name: The Role-Separation Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Sans for hierarchy and ordinary interface reading, and IBM Plex Mono only where values benefit from a visibly technical treatment.

rules.name: The Shell-First Rule
rules.body: Keep authenticated workflows inside the shared sidebar/header frame; at narrow widths, move navigation above content and allow it to scroll horizontally.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layer Rule
rules.body: Use panel tone and a quiet border to establish grouping first; keep shadows soft and avoid using elevation as the only separator.

dos: Do use the dark blue-gray panel sequence as the foundation for authenticated and public surfaces.
Do reserve semantic color accents for actions, integrity cues, and severity states.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the reduced-motion treatment present in the stylesheet.
Do keep data tables horizontally scrollable when their columns cannot fit safely.
donts: Don't use bright warning colors as neutral decoration; keep amber and red tied to status meaning.
Don't flatten layered panels into one undifferentiated background; borders and tonal steps carry hierarchy.
Don't assign a shadow to every element; the shared shadow belongs to panel-like surfaces.
